body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-09

# Summary
Takeaways from five Local Rank Academy courses read on 2026-10-09 from a Google Drive folder: Local SEO Masterclass, "$0 to $10K Month Local SEO Agency Using Rank and Rents", Cold Email Masterclass, SEO Sales Flow Course, and The Ultimate Software Stack for Agencies. The author sells LocalRank.so and Indexsy links and pushes affiliate offers; about half the tactics break Google or FTC rules, so only white-hat parts are kept. Follows on from [Lesson Takeaways 2026-10-08](lib:brain-lesson-takeaways-2026-10-08).

# For clients (Summit, Pipeliners, Alphalete)
1. Master NAP sheet per client, then check the top 15 listings. Summit AZ citations use the real (480) 447-7008, never DNI pool numbers.
2. Bing Places for each client (also feeds Copilot/ChatGPT search).
3. GBP: match primary category to top-3 map competitors; fill services, attributes, description (keyword + metro early); real job photos only (Scott's pipe-damage/lining rule).
4. Weekly Google Posts rotating through service cities.
5. Review system in GHL: send the review link to every customer, no rating screen; respond to all; steady 2 to 4 per month; review-gap target formula.
6. Monthly GSC check of positions 10 to 20 with impressions but no clicks on money pages.
7. Internal linking rules between services, cities, homepage directory, nav and footer.
8. Service x city SERP test (build, merge or drop); keep pages under about 50 percent similar; verified local facts only.
9. 5 to 8 service-and-city-specific FAQs per city page; FAQ schema matches visible FAQs.
10. CRO: CTA above the fold, sticky nav, click-to-call, short forms; confirm test leads reach GHL.
11. Map embeds must match the right city and GBP.
12. Earned local links only.
13. Call tracking tests; do not touch Summit DNI or the Pipeliners 60-second gate.
14. Monthly plain-English reporting tied to leads, dated change log, "months not weeks" expectations.

# For agency sales and outreach
15-minute discovery call questions; 4-part audit deck with projections labeled as projected; bottom-up pricing and a 3-month sprint; onboarding checklist and 90-day roadmap. Brandon FL prospect: plumbing is saturated and parts of Florida home services are private-equity dominated. Cold email via Instantly: separate TAG-branded domain (needs Scott's OK, costs money), SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warmup, 30 to 40 sends per inbox per day, short plain text, 1 email plus 2 to 3 follow-ups, CAN-SPAM address and opt-out, real results only. "GBP but no website" plumbers yield small email lists.

# Do not use
Friend/family or incentivized reviews, review gating, keyword-stuffed or fake GBP details, CTR bots, PBNs and link blasts, Reddit astroturfing, aggregateRating from Google reviews, rank-and-rent in client markets, unverified pitch claims, paid tools without Kim/Scott approval.

# Outdated in the courses
GSC Mobile Usability and Mobile-Friendly Test retired; "Coverage" is now "Page indexing"; GBP Q&A retired; Data Studio is Looker Studio.
